title: Smoked Mackerel Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Asian-inspired stir fry made with smoked mackerel and noodles, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the broccoli and stir-fry until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the smoked mackerel and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, breaking it up with a spatula as it cooks.
Add the cooked noodles, soy sauce, and stir-fry until everything is well combined.
